newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore fraud cops check CAM charges.
newsitem.headline: Singapore fraud cops check CAM charges.

text.p: Singapore's white collar crime busters, the Commercial Affairs Department (CAD), said on Tuesday they were looking into charges of possible fraud against two directors of CAM International Holdings Ltd.
"We have a received a complaint regarding CAM International and we are looking into the matter," a CAD spokeswoman told Reuters.
The complaint was received from the Ministry of Finance and the CAD was doing preliminary checks, but could not say an investigation had been launched, she said.
Auditors Ernst & Young sent a report to the Finance Ministry saying that two directors could have committed breaches of trust in suspicious transactions through CAM subsidiaries.
The report was made public by the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) on Monday night.
CAM officials were not immediately available for comment.
